name: John Holt
source: John Holt Plc consolidated and separate reports and financial statements for the year ended 30 September 2025, consolidated statement of profit or loss (N millions). FY2025 and FY2024 columns read from the audited statement filed with the Nigerian Exchange; FY2023 to FY2020 rows retained from the NGX filing library.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

source_note: Earnings per share are in naira per share; the audited statement reports 120 kobo for FY2025 and 634 kobo for FY2024. Income tax is the net charge or credit for the year, so FY2025 is -105 million (tax expense 7 less the deferred tax release of 112) and FY2024 is 99 million (tax expense 22 plus deferred tax of 77). The stored FY2023 net profit repeated the FY2024 figure and the stored FY2023 earnings per share of -616 kobo was not the filer figure, so both were cleared rather than carried. Net finance costs and income tax are stated as positive charges throughout the row.
